notes: Synthetic draft cases for the 4A product capture bridge. Evidence level is product_http_mockmvc: MockMvc contract capture, no HTTP server started, no real model, no formal material.
Each case binds one real capture produced by agent/src/test/java/com/tianmu/agent/feedback/ReportEvaluationBridgeHttpTest.java. Rebuild the captures before importing.

The product refuses explicit ranges older than 30 days and the task clock is not injectable in this slice, so the delivered window is 2026-11-05..2026-11-12 and the refused-range case keeps its own older window.
material.content declares the fixture the Java test injects through a mocked FeedbackSnapshotPort; the product does not read this text from disk.
Semantic quality stays NOT_ASSESSED and review.status stays pending; nothing here is a human-approved scoring case.
